name: com.dsh.unitybridge
description: File-queue bridge that lets a DSH agent drive the Unity editor: status, scenes, play mode, static-method eval, Roslyn C# scripting, in-place reload, and console log capture. Editor-only, zero network ports.

samples.description: Menu items under Tools > Unity Bridge > Samples that drive the bridge directly: ping, print status, and create a cube via Roslyn scripting.
